description: Estimated current value of the token amounts a wallet received minus sent in its most recent 50 ERC-20 transfers (Blockscout), priced at current DefiLlama prices. It is NOT profit and loss: there is no cost basis, no historical prices, no realised gains, win rate or Sharpe ratio, and transfers older than the latest 50 are missing. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: agent_intel_wallet_pnl_performance_audit
title: Agent Intel Wallet Pnl Performance Audit
